summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments from automated reviewers on the current branch, implementing fixes, replying to threads, and resolving them.
summary.outcome: Three review threads from GitHub Copilot were resolved: log messages reworded to avoid assuming 'no changes', a desktop fallback guard added for failed CI runs, and API error handling added to `gh run list` polling loops. One commit pushed (71234b9) plus a follow-up commit for the polling error handling.

repo: release-gate.yml contains polling loops that call `gh run list` — these lacked error handling for failed API calls, which was flagged by automated review.
The workflow distinguishes web and desktop E2E run polling paths, each needing its own guard against E2E_CONCLUSION != 'success' before allowing fallback.

code.finding: Polling loops for `gh run list` did not check for command failure; error handling was added in a follow-up edit after the initial PR comment fixes.

workflow: Reply to PR review threads via REST using `--field` (not `-f`) for `in_reply_to` since the value must be an integer.
Resolve review threads via GraphQL mutation `resolveReviewThread`; multiple threads can be batched.
PR review comment resolution workflow: triage → fix → test → commit/push → reply → resolve.

friction: Two separate review threads flagged the same underlying issue (`gh run list` not checked for failure), requiring recognition that they were duplicates before fixing.
